coverageNames: Only key names were recorded (the profile kept values out)
coverageNone: Nothing was recorded for this storage
fromSnapshot: From the snapshot at {time} plus the writes after it
noSnapshot: No snapshot: only keys written during the recording
truncated: The snapshot was cut at the recorder's limit
name: Name
namesOnlyDb: Only the database name was recorded.
storeTruncated: Only the first records were recorded.
valueNotKept: The value was not kept by the recording profile.
previousUnknown: The value before this write is not in the recording.
valueUnchanged: The same value was written again.
